confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and city context, not live booking or menu checks. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation. July is peak summer season in Okinawa, so accommodation anchors are set at peak rates and are less certain. FX provenance: the RBA exchange-rates overview page was seen only as a search-result excerpt and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Japanese mid-sized tourist cities outside Tokyo and Osaka, adjusted for Okinawa's summer tourism demand. Naha's restaurant prices are set below Tokyo and Osaka, and its accommodation rates rise sharply in July.
